security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives caused by embedded media, documentation syntax, CSS, static HTML, and quoted shell idioms. Confirmed guidance sources project .env files, while semantic review found unchecked Obsidian paths, untrusted knowledge ingestion, unpinned installation, and non-transactional Notion updates. Review the 31 omitted static matches manually before publication. Static review was capped at 400/431 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 31 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Credential setup guidance sources project-local .env files as shell code.
remediation.suggestion: Use a non-executing dotenv parser or require users to export the token directly. Never source an untrusted repository file.

remediation.issue: Obsidian destination paths can escape the resolved vault.
remediation.suggestion: Canonicalize target and index paths, reject absolute paths and traversal segments, and verify every resolved path remains under the vault before writing.

remediation.issue: External knowledge-base notes are treated as actionable guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Treat retrieved note bodies as untrusted data, ignore embedded instructions, and require source validation before applying a note to project work.

remediation.issue: Lark setup installs unpinned global packages.
remediation.suggestion: Use pinned package versions with documented integrity verification and avoid executing a latest-version npx installer by default.

remediation.issue: Notion updates delete current blocks before the replacement is fully verified.
remediation.suggestion: Create a recoverable backup or staged version before deletion, verify the replacement, and restore automatically when a write fails.

remediation.issue: Thirty-one lower-priority static matches were omitted from the adjudication catalog.
remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted matches before enabling automatic marketplace publication.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Knowledge Can Influence Agent Actions
semantic_findings.description: The consumption workflow tells the agent to read external knowledge-base notes and adopt their conclusions, but it does not treat note content as untrusted. A shared or poisoned note can carry prompt-injection instructions into project work.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly retrieves and applies external note content to concrete output without an instruction-data boundary or provenance validation step.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Global Dependency Installation
semantic_findings.description: The setup flow offers a command that globally installs the latest Lark CLI and executes an npx skill installer. A compromised or changed upstream package can run code with the user's permissions after confirmation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both locations prescribe unpinned, global package installation from the network. The explicit confirmation reduces exposure but does not mitigate upstream package compromise.

semantic_findings.title: Non-Transactional Notion Body Replacement

content.user_title: Build Durable Project Knowledge with Project Cairn
content.value_statement: Project decisions and lessons often disappear across sessions and tools. Project Cairn keeps validated knowledge current and moves approved lessons into reusable knowledge bases.
actual_capabilities: Scaffolds AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cairn configuration, logs, and optional roadmaps after collecting project decisions.
Maintains project logs, roadmaps, and topic notes as work produces verified conclusions.
Audits project knowledge for stale conclusions, contradictions, and missing records.
Searches configured knowledge bases and records pointers when external knowledge influences project work.
Runs provider preflight checks and writes human-approved graduation notes to Obsidian, Notion, or Lark.
Guides branch closure so useful project knowledge is preserved before an exploration branch is removed.
limitations: It has no background service, chat-end hook, or automatic synchronization.
Provider integrations require user-managed credentials, permissions, and local tools.
Shell adapters target macOS and Linux; Windows requires WSL or Git Bash.
Provider update operations can replace existing content and do not provide automatic rollback.

use_cases.title: Preserve Development Context
use_cases.description: Capture verified decisions and progress so an AI-assisted software project survives session changes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Records
use_cases.description: Use one repeatable structure for decisions, roadmaps, audits, and knowledge handoffs across projects.

use_cases.title: Graduate Reusable Lessons
use_cases.description: Prepare approved project lessons for a shared Obsidian, Notion, or Lark knowledge base.

prompt_templates.title: Initialize a Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Initialize Project Cairn in this repository. Ask for the project summary, documentation language, and Git policy before writing files.

prompt_templates.title: Record Progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Record the verified decisions and next steps from this work in the appropriate Cairn log and topic note.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Knowledge
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this project's Cairn records for stale conclusions, contradictions, and missing progress entries. Report findings before changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Graduate a Lesson
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare this validated lesson for graduation to the configured knowledge base. Show the scope and destination, then wait for my confirmation before writing.

output_examples.input: Initialize Project Cairn for a new service.
output: A short list of setup decisions requiring user approval.
A created project configuration and durable documentation structure.
A summary of files created and the selected maintenance rules.

output_examples.input: Audit the project knowledge before release.
output: A list of stale or conflicting topic notes.
Missing log or roadmap records that need attention.
A proposed reusable note with provenance and scope.
The selected provider destination and write plan.
A confirmation request before any external change.

best_practices: Confirm the project scope, Git policy, and provider destination before initialization.
Record only verified conclusions and link detailed evidence instead of duplicating raw material.
Review graduation content for secrets, private data, and provider destination accuracy before confirmation.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a log entry as a substitute for a maintained topic conclusion.
Do not copy complete external knowledge notes into the project when a pointer is sufficient.
Do not run provider writes or update modes without reviewing the exact target and replacement scope.

faq.question: Does Project Cairn run automatically after every chat?
faq.answer: No. It is documentation-first and has no background hook or chat-end trigger.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The package declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Which knowledge bases can receive graduated notes?
faq.answer: The included adapters support Obsidian, Notion, and Lark or Feishu wiki.

faq.question: Are provider writes automatic?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires human confirmation before a provider-side write.

faq.question: Where are credentials stored?
faq.answer: Use a trusted secret store or export variables directly. Do not store credentials in Cairn configuration.

faq.question: Can it migrate all existing project history?
faq.answer: No. Historical migration is optional and requires a separate explicit action.
